copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 此技能让 Claude 在 Cursor 中引导你安装、配置 claude-mem：可选本地或远程 worker，并可在远程推理与本机 host 登录两种观察方式间选择。它会给出对应 npx 命令、环境变量设置与注意事项，且不要求其他 IDE。
howto.when: 当你在 Cursor 中设置 claude-mem（安装 worker、选择本机登录或 cmem.ai 远程推理等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 上安装 claude-mem 本地 worker
say.note: 会运行默认 npx 安装命令并启动本地 worker。

say.text: 我要部署远程 worker，服务器是 https://my-host
把观察方式切换成本机 host 登录

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude walk you through setting up claude-mem in Cursor: pick a local or remote worker, and choose remote inference or a local host-login observer. It outputs matching npx commands, env vars, and caveats. No other IDE is required.
howto.when_en: Triggered when setting up claude-mem in Cursor: installing a worker, choosing local host-login or cmem.ai remote inference, etc.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Cursor with a local worker.
say_en.note: Runs the default npx install and starts the local worker.

say_en.text: Set up a remote worker at https://my-host.
say_en.note: Provides the server-url install command and MCP token setting.

say_en.text: Switch the observer to local host login.
say_en.note: Uses --provider host loopback, no worker port bound.
